bullets.text: UK Age Verification Bug Fixed - **Apple** clarifies that the age verification prompt in iOS 26.4 beta 2 was an error.
Spotify Expands Audiobook Charts - **Spotify** launches new Audiobook Charts for users in the UK to discover titles.
iOS 26.4 Enhances Reminders - **Apple** adds a dedicated smart list for 'Urgent' reminders in the latest iOS update.
Xiaomi Unveils 17 Ultra - **Xiaomi** launches its flagship 17 Ultra smartphone with advanced camera features at MWC 2026.
Galaxy S26 Ultra's Privacy Display - **Samsung** introduces a new Privacy Display feature to enhance user confidentiality.
iPhone 17e Launch Imminent - **Apple** is set to reveal the iPhone 17e with exciting new features next week.
Xiaomi's Leica Leitzphone Review - The **Xiaomi** Leica Leitzphone impresses with its camera capabilities and design.
OpenAI's Pentagon Deal - **OpenAI** secures a deal with the Pentagon for its AI models amidst industry tensions.
